Toxapex: Regenerator, Leftovers, Scald? Not in list, use Liquidation? Actually Toxapex has Liquidation, Baneful Bunker, Recover, Toxic. Use Toxic, Recover, Baneful Bunker, Liquidation. EVs: 32 HP, 32 Def, 2 SpD. Bold.
Garchomp: Garchompite, Rough Skin (pre-mega) or Sand Veil; use Rough Skin. Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Swords Dance, Rock Slide. EVs: 32 Atk, 32 Spe, 2 HP. Jolly.
Clefable: Clefablite, Magic Guard, Moonblast, Calm Mind, Moonlight, Thunder Wave? Or Stealth Rock. Use Moonblast, Calm Mind, Moonlight, Thunder Wave. EVs: 32 HP, 32 SpD, 2 Def? Actually Calm Mind needs SpA; use 32 SpA, 32 SpD, 2 HP. Calm Nature? +SpD -Atk maybe. Use Calm.
Rotom-Wash: Levitate, Wise Glasses, Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt, Volt Switch, Will-O-Wisp. EVs: 32 SpA, 32 Spe, 2 HP. Timid.
